<div class="card-body">
'''Counter Assault''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="photo">[https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/star-wars-ccg-japanese-premiere/imagegallery/29544 Japanese Premiere collector gallery], PSA; [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/202709162/wvmRKBmCNUqxBOLV2wZX6g.jpg Counter Assault original photograph].</ref>

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">反撃</span><ref name="photo" />

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">1フォース消費して、1ヶ所でのフォース消耗をキャンセルできる。その位置にいる敵のキャラクター、宇宙船、ビークルの合計枚数だけ運命数を引く。そして、自分の運命数の合計と、敵の戦闘力の合計を比較し、少ないほうが、その差だけのフォース消耗を受ける。</span><ref name="photo" />

<h2>Lore</h2>
<span lang="ja">帝国のストームトルーパーは、奇襲攻撃への対抗策として、即座に部隊を再編成し、一挙に形勢を逆転する訓練を受けている。これにより、ハン・ソロの型破りな追撃を阻止できた。</span><ref name="photo" />

<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Counterattack<ref name="photo" />

'''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to cancel a Force drain at one location. Draw as many destiny as the total number of opposing characters, starships and vehicles at that location. Compare your total destiny with the opponent's total power; the player with the lower total loses Force equal to the difference.<ref name="photo" />

'''Lore:''' Imperial stormtroopers are trained to regroup immediately and reverse the situation in response to surprise attacks. This enabled them to halt [[Han Solo]]'s unconventional pursuit.<ref name="photo" />

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Both printed texts spend 1 Force to cancel a drain at one location, draw destiny for the opponent's characters, starships and vehicles there, and compare that total with the opponent's power. The Japanese lore emphasizes immediate regrouping and reversing the situation; the English describes tactical training to regroup and mount a surprise counterattack.<ref name="photo" /><ref name="english-face">[[:File:Premiere-D-counterassault.gif|Counter Assault original English printed face]].</ref>
